case.court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
case.limits: Thumbnails were degraded and pointed back to the source. A generative system produces new full-quality artefacts and does not necessarily send anyone anywhere, which plaintiffs argue breaks the analogy.
case.holding: A search engine that copied photographs and displayed them as thumbnails made fair use, because the thumbnails served an indexing function rather than the original artistic one.

case.why_ai_cites_it: The earliest clear holding that ingesting a corpus wholesale to build an index is transformative. It is the direct ancestor of the argument that training is an indexing-like act rather than a competing publication.
